ModMetaData.name: Yayo's Combat 3 - Auto Reload Regression Fix
ModMetaData.author: FlowMorph
ModMetaData.description:
作者 / Author: FlowMorph 源码与发布 / Source and releases: https://github.com/FlowMorph/YayosCombatAutoReloadFix
恢复 Yayo's Combat 3 - Addon 1.6.10 中存在、在 1.6.11 被删除的 UsedOnce 自动换弹触发。
修复 NPC 背包中有匹配弹药却不换弹，以及开启 refillMechAmmo 时非 Humanlike Pawn 打空后无法自动补弹的问题。
默认开启“NPC 空枪换弹重试”：非玩家阵营 Pawn 的主武器为空且背包中有足量匹配弹药时，每隔约 2～3 秒尝试换弹。检查按 Pawn 错峰执行，不搜索地图弹药，也不修改 AI 或 ThinkTree。
依赖：Harmony、Yayo's Combat 3 (Continued)、Yayo's Combat 3 - Addon。请将本补丁放在三个依赖之后。
Restores the UsedOnce auto-reload trigger present in Yayo's Combat 3 - Addon 1.6.10 and removed in 1.6.11.
Fixes NPCs failing to reload matching ammunition from inventory and non-Humanlike pawns failing to receive the existing refillMechAmmo behavior after emptying a weapon.
The optional NPC empty-weapon reload retry is enabled by default. Every 2–3 seconds, staggered per pawn, non-player pawns with an empty primary weapon and enough matching inventory ammunition may retry reloading. It does not search the map for ammunition or modify AI/ThinkTrees.
Requires Harmony, Yayo's Combat 3 (Continued), and Yayo's Combat 3 - Addon. Load this patch after all three dependencies.
